description: Effects and behaviour: PLAN.md steps 14-17. Animated water/waterfalls/clouds/flags/sway/glow/sparkles, node state visuals, quality governor, avatar walking, follow/glide/warp camera, recenter, progress/availability API, kingdom gating, padlock/mist, entry animations, gate + title banner + camera travel, legacy and new events, accessibility proxies, reduced motion, responsive/DPR, full demo controls.
